[LEXP.9.4.1] `<binding>::Json` in a `call` action serialises a whole
schema-typed fact to JSON-on-wire for outbound web API calls. The cast — its
form, totality, and the fact-only rule (any fact-typed source; `scalar → Json`
rejected) — is specified in [LCST.4.5.10]; [LCST.4.6] governs the
`Json(<binding>)` call form. See
[LGRA.9.6] for the postfix grammar.
